description: This file defines the TasksAdapter class for a RecyclerView in an Android app, used for displaying and managing a list of NoteTask items with support for diffing, item movement, and font size adjustments.

classes.name: TasksAdapter
classes.description: An adapter for RecyclerView to display a list of NoteTask items with support for diff utility, item reordering, font size adjustments, and binding layout.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the tasks list.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new TaskViewHolder with layout bindings and styling.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a NoteTask item to the provided TaskViewHolder.

methods.name: moveItem
methods.description: Swaps two tasks in the list and notifies RecyclerView of the move.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Submits a new list of NoteTask items; optionally uses DiffUtil to animate changes.

methods.name: setFontSize
methods.description: Sets the font size to be used in list item views.
